notes.title: Devlog #8:Sea battle and new demo update
notes.notes:
Hey guys

For several weeks, we developing new system in Perang Laut-Maritime Warfare: Sea battle

So what's like sea battle in this game? This several screenshots how like the sea battle in this game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/0c46b12a40c6287192744bfd0961edef99563ac4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/b405927619c6867a6e017a475da4655cc788a75e.jpg[/img]
There are 4 orders in commanding ships:
1.Hit and run:attacking with arrows/guns/cannons(depends on technology ) and use speed of ships 
2.Boarding:attacking enemy by boarding to enemy ships and takeover each ships. This order very useful for large number of troop
3.Burning: burning ship and attacking it to enemy ship.
4.Flee:running from battle.

This is what we can tell for now.

New demo update has updated several days ago and have some new features.

For new update for main build the Perang Laut-Maritime Warfare, hope we can finish it before 24 November 2021.

Thank you.

notes.title: Devlog #7 Sieging the port
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, how are you?

Currently, we update many things including font colour for ports
You can see in this screenshot
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/a1e787c2f252b6584cd80ff51ec2de7b572e7221.jpg[/img]
 Beside upating AI and historical contants, we add new system:Siege.

If you have play the demo or full build Perang Laut-Maritime Warfare, you will find if ship attacking enemy port, ship's troop will start the assault.

Now for new build and demo (yes, we will update the demo soom), there are siege system. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/ea93671a319f781bd1383066691eb84d94485b8d.jpg[/img]

What is it?  This system will allow you (and another attacker) to choose 3 option; bombarding the port, assault, or siege.

Bombarding will let ships or troops cannon/archer to firing the port so the defense will decreasing and the defender morale will decreasing. Assault will let your troop attack port directly but wll risk if the defense port really high. The last option, siege, is waiting your troop ready to attack or just siege port until they run out food and easily to attack.

Maybe if the inspiration come more early, we probably add this system but sadly, the inspiration come late.

Thank you for reading this. Hope we can update as soon as possible the build

notes.title: Devlog #6: New features in 1512 Campaign
notes.notes:
Dear everyone 

Currently we prepare new update for historical campaign 1512. Unlike previous update, this update take long time. Probably in 14-15 November, the new update complated and uploaded in Steamworks.

Beside fixing many bugs, we add new features

[b]>New Port!  [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/dd1baba1249515ee50cea76aa7a7e74cb874bed7.jpg[/img]
[b]1.Jepara[/b]
Jepara in 16th century was important harbor in Java. Near from Demak, Jepara plays critical position in new Sultanate of Demak with lord of Pati Unus, 2nd ruler of Demak, was ruler of Jepara (Crown Prince).

[b]2.Pasuruan[/b]
Pasuruan is Blambangan capital in early 16th century before push more eastern by Mataram. Pasuruan is the eastern border between Sultanate of Demak against Blambangan.

[b]>New unplayable factions[/b]

[b]1.Samudra Pasai[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/7b1df52f18cd857893254b44386e2924f66f83c7.jpg[/img]
Samudra Pasai is first sultanate in Indonesia's history located in Pasai, Aceh and become important port in Strait of Mallaca before Sultanate of Mallaca established Mallaca

[b]2.Negara Daha[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/d3a90a0d7d9f0730fe92bc511b7378dbb6bf0e6a.jpg[/img]
Before Sultanate of Banjarmasin, Negara Daha was notable kingdom in South Borneo and in middle 1512 campaign, Banjarmasin will appers as new kingdom and ask Demak to help them against Negara Daha in inner South Borneo!

[b]>New Features[/b]

1.[b]Europan's activity[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/908ecac8259ba8beeaef3a25fcf5ed613068e85d.jpg[/img]
Portuguese and many Europans which permitted to stay in native factions can establish trading post, Jesuit's mission, or build the fort. This will impact many things like native conversion to catholic

So how about 1630 campaign? Yes, this campaign will get many update too including historical elements.

This is information we can reveal now.. Hope we can upload the new update soon.

Thank you

notes.title: Perang Laut Maritime Warfare has released!
notes.notes:
Dear everyone, 

After 1 week delayed, finally we can released Perang Laut Maritime Warfare in Steam since long time development from April 2021 (recontinue development from May 2017-June 2019).  If you have play the demo version and wishlist the game, this is time you can try to play another factions with long time duration play!

Reason delayed was there are some AI problems and need more time to fix it. Now most of AI problem has been fixed. We will improve the AI especially in historical campaign. You can access this campaign after clear one of 11 factions in standard campaign by collecting victory points, You can get it from winning naval battle, conquer, trading rights, and get tribute from your vasal. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/7260f121e79093dfa79c96ab9ac54671d3de545e.jpg[/img]
So if you has collected victory points, you will get achivement and can access 1512 campaign. If you complate one from two factions objective, you can access 1630 campaign. 

New update will come in 31 October to 2 November 2021 (target to release date). This update relate with historical campaigns.

Thank you!

Sengkala Dev

notes.title: Devlog #5 Mandala Power and About Release date
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Long time not to update the devlog since Sengkala Dev busy in making AI about 1 month..

In Perang Laut, faction's system use mandala against another factions for war. Trade rights depends how good relation between factions like and allies system depends on war( your enemy my enemy is our enemy )

So what is mandala? Mandala is imaginer circle fame the ruler and related ancient Indian and Southeast Asian political system . So when two mandala circle clashed, war will start like Srivijaya's mandala clash with Mallaca. Wait, Mallaca is Islam so is their still use mandala? Yes. Mandala system widely used even for Eastern Indonesian kingdoms such as Ternate and Tidore although have different concept.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/8a9dcc0b22b5f8784be7b9f06ceb5fc7d9d2b310.jpg[/img]

So this system quite unique right? Probably you have see this system in demo.

About release date. 18 October is release date (19 October in Indonesia). Probably the release date will change since game still under development (AI problem). Hope we can release in this week.

Thank you for your attention

notes.title: Devlog #4 Historical campaigns
notes.notes:
Hey guys..

If you read in features in storepage, there are historical campaigns.

Yes, there are 2 historical campaigns : 1512 and 1630. 

1512 Campaign is campaign where Portuguese presence start from Mallaka and begin to expand in Indonesia archipelago. Majapahit replaced with Demak, first sultanate in Java.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/75f30a8b656f85a024938381ab2e5102d1137e80.jpg[/img]
(Portuguese in Mallaca)

 1630  Campaign is campaign where VOC (Dutch East India Company) become more strong in Indonesia archipelago from repel the 2nd Mataram invasion in Batavia, control spices trade in Mollucas, and more! Srivijaya replaced with  Sultanate of Palembang, Mallaca replaced with Johor, and Demak replaced with Mataram. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/2000e64696ebb12aaa6360d4d9d95e75947aad5a.jpg[/img]
(Portuguese in Batavia)

Historical and standard campaigns menu 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/82c7a34d67ef03904bc61bf2dd939c34255c86f1.jpg[/img]

Thank you for reading this short devlog

notes.title: Devlog#3 Minor factions and Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, nice to meet you.

In Perang Laut-Maritime Warfare, there are 11 native factions which playable and 4 Europan powers (Portuguese, Spanish, Dutch, and English).
Beside it there are minor factions. What is it?

Minor factions is small kingdom/sultanate or strategic kingdom but didn't have any strong maritime power.

There are total 46 factions which 31 factions is unplayable factions like Banten, Pajajaran, and Pagauruyung. This probably will add more if there are any update in future

Before diplomatic system, this factions mostly useless, but now they have better position.. 

Example:

Majapahit want to conquer Pajajaran, but must declare war against Pajajaran. If Majapahit attacking Pajajaran, Pajajaran's friend maybe will concern with this situation and harm the relation with Majapahit. Another example Mallaca declare war against Pattani but Pattani is friend of Aceh. Aceh probably will intervate the war.

This is several screenshots aboutminor factions.

notes.title: #Devlog 1 Perang Laut Maritime Warfare
notes.notes:
Perang Laut Maritime Warfare or shorted as “Perang Laut’ is historical real time strategy set on maritime power in Indonesia archipelago. Factions appers in campaign taken from 7th century to 18th century which 11 factions is playable.  Each factions have different characteristic, power, and specializing in constructing ship. The main objective for each factions taken from the background of faction’s expansion and ambition such as Majapahit want to conquer/control strategic place in many islands, or Aceh want conquer many place in Sumatra and Malaya. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/5c9c90ba1c0daa51c8dc58c7be7dd438fcff16da.png[/img]
(old screenshot of Perang Laut)

The idea of this game came in day dreaming in early Febuary 2014 and after that, first time my game development started with game project called Perang Laut and in March 2014 become Pedalahusa. But at that time, my game project only just for learning the game development and making the strategy game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/33f0724f70223f8fde5139a9dbc17419146bedb5.png[/img]
(old screenshot of Perang Laut)

In November 2015, I starting making Pedalahusa Fall of Bali, strategy game set in Bali in 19th century after very exicted reading history of Bali in 19th century by Anak Agung Gede Agung. But since I still learning the game development while focus in my collage life as new history student, the game progress very slow and I declare the project of Fall of Bali done in January 2017 after I lose my motivation in this game.

After done with Fall of Bali, I read there are board game submission from board game developer. I want try my luck with making board game about Perang Laut. I sent it and my board game project rejected. Since I think my board game project will good if I adopt it in PC game. The project started in first week May 2017 and first time I show it to public at Jakarta Game Developer gathering.

For long time making it alone (with support my comrade, Raden Agung as composer, and my friends in history program Universitas Indonesia), the development process take long time. 

Twice time this game exhibited in public exhibition in middle July 2018 at Indonesia Gaming Xperience and early October 2019 at Indonesia Ministry of Industry. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/51988c266e71f6eeb5b1376fefa08f94e6fe47d9.jpg[/img]

Join in as finalist in Increfest competition in Bandung  at 12-13 September 2019 but lose. In January 2019, Perang Laut have big chance to have Steam page, but failed since money for Steam Direct put in Steam Wallet. This is make big trouble at that time 

Now, new phase come in middle 2021 when we got assists from another team improving the graphic and feedback for gameplay.

Perang Laut Maritime Warfare have steam page (before only Itch.io and Gamejolt) after lose the chance in January 2019. The release date actually tentative since there are Steam Next Fest and this release date probably target for this game to keep improving the quality until many people like this game and enjoy it for long time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/4fa369c89def12663dcbf8ecd72b985db2336b96.png[/img]

Demo of Perang Laut in Steam will come soon...
There are demo of this game in Itch.io version. You can search it and play but the different from demo of Steam version is this game will have steam achivements...
